name: message
title: Message
description: One turn of a conversation, as a bubble that points at its author.
use: The turns of a chat or a thread, in any list. A received turn stands at the start of the row; a sent one stands at the end in ink.

instead.when: The words are quoted in an article, not said in a conversation
The notice comes from the page itself, not from a person
It is the field where the next message is written

classes.name: message
classes.description: A received turn, at the start of the row. It stands 12px from the turn before it and 4px when both come from the same side

classes.name: message-sent
classes.description: A turn of your own: the row mirrors and the bubble is ink

classes.name: message-avatar
classes.description: The author's avatar, level with the foot of the bubble; it goes on the avatar itself and may be left out

classes.name: message-bubble
classes.description: The words, in a bubble whose tight corner points at the author

classes.name: message-meta
classes.description: A name, a time or a receipt under the bubble

classes.name: message-typing
classes.description: Three dots that rise in turn, inside a bubble that carries role="status" and a label such as "Ada is typing"

properties.name: --message-tail
properties.description: The corner that points at the author
